value.draft: A hospital can list a new trial on the platform by first contacting platform support to obtain listing guidelines. Next, they should prepare all required trial documentation, such as the protocol, informed consent forms, and IRB approval. Finally, the hospital can submit the trial details through the platform's portal, following the provided instructions to ensure all information is complete and accurate. This process helps ensure the trial is properly listed and accessible to eligible participants.
